# opentoolbook8 0.1.0

First release of opentoolbook8, the clean-room ToolBook 8 reader. The version is the `0.1.0` already in `pyproject.toml`.

## At this tag (main `6c6da4a`)

- `python3 -m opentoolbook book.tbk` opens the book on the page its startup handlers name, in a live Tk window (#114).
- Pages draw the background, rectangles, ellipses, lines, class `0x10` polygons, class `0x11` arcs unfilled from their prototype radii (#115), fields, button pictures, and now button captions in the button's font (#120, roadmap O2). Pie geometry is read and the wedge paint is refused (#116).
- Navigation is click-verified through the Logic Families intro chain, the TTL and Other ICs sections, Help, Summary, Definition HelpNext, the Pre-Test and the score page.
- `AGENTS.md` matches the pull-request workflow (#118, O0) and the stale `RESEARCH.md` notes are fixed (#119, O1).
- 394 tests OK plain (173 skipped without the book).

## Not yet

- Dotted lines draw solid (O3, PR #121 open). `forward` has no body (O4). Books seeded before startup get no `enterSystemBook` (O5).

## Next release point

`v0.2.0` when O3, O4 and O5 of roadmap #117 are merged. A release PR moves `pyproject.toml` to `0.2.0` and adds `.github/release-notes/v0.2.0.md`; merging it publishes the release.
